ExtremeLow.description: severe low light; signal close to RAW noise floor
ExtremeLow.sensor_saturation_formula: sensor_saturation_ev = interp(sensor_saturation_ev_range, lighting_sample_unit) when configured, else max(lighting_ev - 1.5, 0.0) * 0.12
